label: Microsoft
geographicScope: Within 50 miles of a Microsoft office
assumptions: The best-of-window BELT measurement scheme is Badgy's own modelling choice; Microsoft says three days a week in the office without specifying a measurement window, rolling average or best-of calculation.
The 80%/90% band thresholds are Badgy's own, not published by Microsoft.
The stated minimum is 3 days a week, which scores 60% under BELT, so the bands are aspirational.
Business travel not counting as office time is Badgy's convention, not confirmed policy.
